column1: # Firmware bundled into the AppImage: device<TAB>repository-relative artifact<TAB>SHA256.
# Only the OBD2HUD image is bundled. Other device firmware comes from the files imported from the user's SRS installer.
# Device IDs the staging script accepts: intellibox-v5, intellibox-v6, belt, obd2hud.
# obd2hud: built from this repository and NOT YET TESTED on a real OBD2HUD. It is sent to a HUD only when no
# firmware has been imported from an SRS installer; an imported image always takes its place.
